findings.finding: cli-args-parser and tuiuiu.js publish their own declaration surfaces; current resolver finds both JS and declarations at all actual imported subpaths; current auto-eligibility heuristic accepts all three specifiers. Missing npm typing is not the explanation for their baseline SC2013 refusals.
findings.caveat: Heuristic eligibility is not full lowering or successful native compilation. Baseline does not retain per-package fallback reason and uses an older compiler.

findings.finding: Both installed manifests have no runtime/optional/peer dependencies. AST traversal of actual imported entrypoints finds no external npm import, require, or nonliteral dependency edge; only Node builtins. No untyped transitive npm package is evidenced in this red-dev dependency graph.
findings.caveat: Conservative module syntax reachability includes barrel exports/conditional imports; it is not function reachability, execution tracing, or a native support guarantee for Node builtins.

findings.finding: Original tsconfig requests types:[bun-types], but this pnpm installation directly exposes @types/bun 1.3.14 and not bun-types. A bounded TypeScript probe reports TS2688 for bun-types. types:[bun] resolves the installed public dependency and removes that options diagnostic in the controlled probe.
findings.suggestedConsumerAction: Align the type directive with the direct dependency (types:[bun]) or declare/install bun-types directly if that directive is intentional; preserve lockfile/install reproducibility. No edit performed.
findings.caveat: Scriptc already separately resolves the installed bun surface; the 773 baseline has no SC0001 type-directive error. This is not an explanation for all native refusals and no full consumer tsc run was performed.

findings.owner: compiler project declaration adoption and Bun asset lowering
findings.finding: All 21 literal any SC2011 diagnostics in the baseline are Bun asset imports, not imports of untyped npm packages. Consumer shims already declare string for .sh/.conf/.kdl/.png/.ttf/.embedded, covering 20 sites. The current compiler constructs entry/ambient/runtime type roots without adopting tsconfig-included project declaration roots. A bounded TS probe types font/shell as string when original shims are present and any when absent.
findings.suggestedCompilerAction: Adopt applicable project ambient declarations and implement the explicit Bun text/file loader contract. Correct types alone cannot embed assets or supply runtime file paths.

findings.owner: consumer type contract plus compiler asset semantics
findings.finding: The remaining starship.toml import requests type:text. bun-types declares *.toml as any for generic TOML modules, while the consumer local shims omit .toml. With installed Bun types and local shims loaded, the probe has no diagnostics but configToml remains any.
findings.suggestedAction: Specify the text-content string contract at this asset boundary and teach the compiler to honor the explicit text loader; do not treat generic TOML any as an untyped runtime npm dependency.
findings.caveat: A wildcard declaration must accurately distinguish text content from parsed TOML imports; blindly making every TOML value a string would be unsound.

findings.finding: The baseline contains 177 SC2020 diagnostics for already-typed APIs, including Bun.spawn/write/which/file-related calls and subprocess streams/exits, plus typed standard operations. It also has 5 SC2011 representation failures on named/structural types and 294 propagated SC2004 diagnostics. Adding types to consumer code cannot itself implement these APIs.
findings.caveat: Historical diagnostic locations, not 773 independent bugs or confirmed-current counts. Variadic/other compiler changes since baseline may already remove some.

findings.finding: scripts/redwall-bin-main.ts is a staging template, not a standalone entry at its current location. Its three relative source imports are absent in scripts/, and the documented .red/tmp/redwall-build/src staging tree is also absent. The entry also imports REDWALL_SUBSET_BYTES, an export generated by the preparation script and absent from original src/redwall-font.ts. The baseline three SC0001 diagnostics therefore identify missing generated source prerequisites, not npm types.
findings.suggestedConsumerAction: Provide the intended prepared entry and generated assets, or maintain a canonical source entry whose imports resolve in its actual source location. No preparation/build script executed.

findings.owner: consumer build reproducibility and compiler compatibility roadmap
findings.finding: The existing script does more than staging: it replaces brand code, stubs type modules, substitutes Float64Array/arithmetic, and changes PNG compression from level 9 to default before invoking scriptc --dynamic without an explicit Rust pin. This is not proof of native Rust compilation of the unchanged original graph, nor an equivalent-source benchmark.
findings.suggestedCompilerAction: Remove compatibility rewrite requirements through compiler support, then compare fixed original source/options/assets against the Bun build. Preserve necessary resource packaging as a consumer prerequisite.
findings.caveat: Comments asserting old sizes/timings and the existing vendor binary were not re-benchmarked and are not accepted as current performance evidence.

recommendedOrder: consumer: align Bun type directive and establish authoritative Redwall staged/canonical source entry and assets
